# Upstream License Texts

This file reproduces, verbatim, the `LICENSE` files distributed in the upstream
npm tarballs of the packages vendored into this directory. Both packages are
MIT-licensed. See [VERSIONS.md](./VERSIONS.md) for source URLs and SHA-256
pins of the vendored bytes.

The bootroom binary embeds the entire `crates/bootroom/web/vendor/` directory
via `include_dir!`, so this file is shipped with every release artifact and
satisfies the MIT attribution requirement.
